name: twinkle_star
description: Twinkle Star is a cute and fun juvenile script. It comes in two stylistic styles: A Script with a more curvy quality and a casual style with more children writing resemblance. It comes with Latin Character sets including Western, Central, and Vietnamese language support. To contribute, see github.com/googlefonts/twinkle-star .
